resolution.note: regraded() keeps gold across verify --id; unit test regraded keeps gold; gold: 1 restored on t-2blfi57

title: Screening verify keeps manifest fields it does not own when it re-grades a unit
body:
On 2026-11-17 the t-g0w638s lane (#1333, fd1954b) re-graded t-2blfi57 with 'node evals/units/screening.ts verify --id'; the rewritten manifest row lost its 'gold: 1' field, because verify writes the record anew instead of merging it with the existing row.
Outcome: re-grading a unit keeps every manifest field the grade does not own (gold and any annotation); t-2blfi57 gets its gold field back.
Proof: a unit test re-grades a manifest row carrying gold: 1 and asserts the field survives.
